summary: feat(settings): add the inline passwordless Sync setup page
description:
Because:
- A Sync sign-in that used a passkey and then a password is where the offer
  to skip the password next time costs no extra device prompt.

This commit:
- Adds the InlinePasswordlessSyncSetup page alongside the other post-sign-in
  interstitials.
- Renders a success banner, the Sync illustration, the offer copy, an enable
  button and a decline link.
- Shows an error banner in place of the success banner when storing fails.

Closes #FXA-14424
